study: Stack verification: the same daily proposals on images built from two commits, on the VM rehearsal through the public API
stack: deploy/vm rehearsal (proxy, booking and daily pools, VM compute caps; the development routing service capped to the VM partition), shipped routing and admission defaults, embedded calculation
protocol: Step 1: 1 planner, synchronous, fleets 10, 20, 50 technicians x 3 visits, points seeds 1, 2, 3, 4 proposals each. Step 2: 2 planners queuing (respond-async), 20 technicians, seed 4, 12 proposals. Search 10 s cost + 5 s fairness. Roads cold at each run's start, never warmed. Order: step 1 before then after, step 2 after then before. Daily pool with SCHEDULER_STUDY_RECEIPTS=true and TIMEFOLD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO; the kit reads each receipt and pairs it with its request's Timefold phase speeds.
